verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine and model platform, so a unified model, prompt and configuration manager is a fair question for it. The evidence never shows one. The pack documents model downloads, a CLI and a platform dashboard for fine-tuning, but nothing about managing downloaded models, saving prompts, or storing per-model configurations in one place. A community critique notes that models download inline at runtime, with no separate download-or-cache API.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can manage my downloaded models, saved prompts, and per-model configurations in one place
